title: Activity count on the ticket and ticket-activities API: still missing
date: TAVI 9 Nov 2026 (NDC-Staging API) · Zoho Desk API docs

panels.caption: API results, 9 Nov 2026
text: GET /desk/tickets/{id}: counts = replies, comments, attachments, time_entries; no activity count.

panels.caption: Zoho Desk API
text: The Ticket API returns taskCount (number of tasks on the ticket).
GET /tickets/{id}/activities (sortBy, isCompleted, isSpam, include), plus /tickets/{id}/tasks, /calls and /events.
Ready-made filters: dueDate=Overdue / Today / Tomorrow, and /tasks/count.
